displayDescription: A sleepy doodle lightbulb gets an idea and links up four mint friends into a connected system on cool graph paper.
audioDescription: Silent preview; no soundtrack, effects or voice.
limitations: Hand-drawn wobble is approximated with seeded Rough.js outlines (3 fixed variants per pose), not real hand-drawn frames.
The graph-paper texture is a procedural SVG grid with a vignette, not a scanned paper material.

Typography relies on macOS system fonts declared with @font-face local(): Chalkboard SE, then Marker Felt, then Comic Sans MS, then generic cursive. If none are installed on the render host, the text falls back to a generic font.
